summary: Validated extended NivX Forge Offline Investigation Report (case-aware, dynamic-format). Backend 13/13 pass — case_type detection (malware/dns_proxy/mixed), format parser (paragraphs/lines/sentences/bullets/verbose), 5W1H hit multiplicity (× N), action counts (blocked/allowed/quarantined), templated recommendations, and regressions on batch-summary/lookup-batch/enrich-iocs/ai-summary. Frontend E2E on /nivx-forge confirms the new forge-report-case pill renders with correct color per case (red malware / amber dns_proxy / fuchsia mixed) and toast wording matches spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still >5900 lines — the forge_* helpers (~330 lines) plus batch-summary would move cleanly to /app/backend/modules/forge_report.py.

In _compose_forge_report paragraphs branch, when count>1 & not verbose, the chunk math can emit fewer than N when body is short — pad-loop covers it but split can also emit >N which is folded; edge case tested and works, keep an eye.
recommendations list for 'mixed' case relies on order-preserving dedup that drops the DNS-proxy-only lead-in — acceptable per spec (dedup).
seed_data_creation: None. All test data ephemeral, inline payloads only.
